desc:
Welcome to Card Battles - a 1v1 card-based fighting game with unique and funny animations. Easy to pick up but challenging to master, this game will test your anticipation and strategy. Are you ready to begin your journey?

🧠 Outsmart your opponents by predicting their moves and playing your cards wisely
🎴 Open new cards from packs and choose which ones to duel with
🥋 Earn your belts as you progress through your journey
🏆 Climb your way to the top of the leaderboard or play for fun

💎 Use code "welcome" for free gems
❤️ LIKE the game for more codes and updates

Premium Benefits
+ 50% More Gems
+ 10% More XP
